instructions: 1. Run workflow:set-up-a-business-on-trillion first if record:business-setup:facts does not exist yet; this workflow reads that row.
2. Say "Run workflow:measure-the-funnel-and-set-a-baseline"; it uses the four default stages: visit, checkout, paid, opened.
3. Read the counts per stage and the breakdown by source each step hands back; a stage with no records counts as zero.
4. The baseline lands in record:business-setup:baseline and is read back; compare later runs to it.

worked_examples.title: Count each funnel stage for a bakery site
worked_examples.ask: Measure my bakery funnel and set the baseline.
worked_examples.given: Read from the measure-stages step in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json: tool:measure-funnel-stages is given one record per visit or sale, stage_ids ["visit","checkout","paid","opened"] and amount_field amount_cents. Example records: 40 visits, 6 checkouts, 2 sales of 1200 cents each, 2 first-file opens.

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
